title: Review Finding Budget
fixture_requirements: Seven independently reachable blockers across concern axes: fixed-30-day proration contradicting the branch's own documented per-calendar-day convention (B1), injection (B2), non-atomic delete (B3), renewal rounding diverging from checkout (B4), seat race (B5), naive parse of legacy DD.MM.YYYY dates with two consequences (B6), owner-as-id derefed as object + nullable owner (B7).
Exact-duplicate pair: B7 reachable from invoiceEmail and renewalNotice (same root, consequence, fix).
Shared-root pair: B6 naive parse drives two consequences (trials never expire — revenue; banner prints Invalid Date — customer-facing).
Two should-fix (SF1 no teams tests, SF2 swallowed gateway error) and one nit (N1 inline name-length literal).
Branch adds no test files; the suite passes so every defect survives only through review discovery.
deterministic_checks: git -C <target-dir> status --porcelain (must be empty before and after a review run)
